expanded_phrases.set up that workflow: Create a resumable local CLI and testable handoff, not a silent real external automation.
expanded_phrases.static opener: Generate or plan a short One Time-branded opener before the trimmed class recording.
expanded_phrases.cut all the weird stuff: Use explicit sidecar or configured trim start/end values in v1, record cut points, and leave automatic semantic start/end detection as a later packet.
expanded_phrases.go into Vimeo: Run existing Vimeo/library dry-run handoff now; require private smoke and approval before any real Vimeo upload.
expanded_phrases.get transcribed: Carry transcript text/status sidecar metadata and prepare the transcription handoff without committing raw transcripts.
expanded_phrases.student portal: Student/member visibility requires approved class/session/library publish gates and live-smoke proof.
expanded_phrases.knowledge base of that bot: Only approved One Time transcript/class-session context can feed scoped bot knowledge.
